prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.3%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Interactive Pet Selection Stage', 'Account Persistence Clarification Hint']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Direct Launch Call-to-Action', 'Streamlined Onboarding Story Copy', 'Visual Waiting Progress Ticker', 'Post-Adoption Sign-In Shift', 'Choose Path Spotlight Layout Redesign', 'Desktop Controls Onboarding Guide', 'Desktop Pet Progress & Time Estimator', 'Interactive Pet Trait Selection Stage', 'Desktop Controls Checklist Overview', 'Ready Notification Toggle', 'Interactive Story Scroll Experience', 'Adoption Certificate Split Layout', 'Path Decision Action Copy', 'Sign In Connection Failure Recovery Alert', 'Desktop Visibility Status Check']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Move Sign In After Pet Choice', 'Desktop Controls Tutorial Screen', 'Path Selector Split View Redesign', 'Account Sync Safeguard Hint', 'Customizer Fallback Step', 'Account Sync Safeguard Sign-In Hint', 'Adoption Certificate Card Layout', 'Clear Path Outcome Headlines', 'Sign In Existing Account Notice', 'Custom Pet Quality Preview Screen']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Evidence remains thin for adoption new_flow, finish copy, finish hint, finish redesign, sign_in hint, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder because each has only been tested once.
For choose_path copy changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
For choose_path redesign changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
For home wait_info changes (4 tests), no clear winning effect was demonstrated, with three tests showing no clear effect and one rolled back due to a guardrail.
For adoption redesign changes (2 tests), results disagree with one winning test and one showing no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to noise-corrected measurements across most tests.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Interactive Desk Companion Mini Game
candidates.change: Adds an interactive desk toy mini-game screen during the waiting stage while background pet creation completes.
candidates.why: Home stage has high median (201s) and mean (2336s) duration, causing drop-offs; providing a mini-game keeps users engaged.

waiting.hint: Play a quick mini-game while your pet prepares its room!

new_waiting_minigame.headline: Toy Workshop
new_waiting_minigame.body: Tap items on the desk to build your pet's first favorite toy while setup finishes.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Quick Action Carousel
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro welcome section into an interactive desktop controls carousel demonstrating how to move, hide, and summon the pet.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2% and support received multiple tickets regarding confusion over controlling, hiding, or talking to the desktop pet.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Swipe through quick tips to learn how to interact with your pet on screen.

home_welcome.text: Drag to move • Double click to talk • Right-click to send to tray

candidates.title: Pet Voice and Personality Setup Flow
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated personality and voice selector screen right before the final adoption certificate is issued.
candidates.why: Adoption stage experiences significant drop-off (66.2% conversion); adding high-value personalization deepens emotional investment before finalization.

new_personality_selector.headline: Choose Personality & Voice
new_personality_selector.body: Select how your pet talks and behaves on your desktop.

candidates.title: Pet Archetype Carousel Selection
candidates.change: Rebuilds the path selector into a carousel layout with rich visual cards highlighting distinct pet behavior archetypes.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a long mean time (514s); a structured visual carousel simplifies comparison and accelerates choice.

choose_path.headline: Pick Your Companion Archetype
choose_path.body: Explore different pet personalities designed for work and play.

candidates.title: Pet Hatching Animation Progress Info
candidates.change: Adds an animated hatching pet graphic and background status explanation to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Support receives tickets about desktop pet apps stalling, and the home stage mean duration is 2336s.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Hatching...
waiting.body: Setting up desktop graphics engine and companion AI response files.

candidates.title: Account Recovery and Instant Reconnect Copy
candidates.change: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly highlight pet retrieval and existing account protection.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or account reset confusion after signing in.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save & Restore Your Pets
sign_in.body: Log into your account so your desktop companion and saved accessories are safely backed up.
sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pet stays safe across device restarts or app updates.

candidates.title: Desktop Overlay Hotkey Helper Hint
candidates.change: Displays an explicit hotkey shortcut tip on the final screen explaining how to toggle desktop visibility.
candidates.why: Support received multiple inquiries post-onboarding asking how to hide or reveal the desktop pet.

home_intro.hint: Quick tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to hide or bring your pet to the front!

candidates.title: Starter Companion Accessory Reward
candidates.change: Displays an exclusive welcome gift badge on the pet selection screen for completing adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 66.2%; granting a starter item boosts conversion motivation.

pick_friend.headline: Adopt Your Companion & Claim Free Accessory
pick_friend.body: Every adoption today comes with an exclusive founder's desktop toy badge!

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Sound Alert
candidates.change: Adds a sound cue component and explicit notification message when waiting finishes.
candidates.why: Home mean time is over 38 minutes as users switch windows; an audio chime alerts them when the pet is ready.

candidates.title: Path Switch Flexibility Guarantee Hint
candidates.change: Adds reassurance text stating paths and companion types can be switched anytime in settings.
candidates.why: High mean decision time on choose_path (514s) points to user hesitation over making an irreversible choice.

choose_path.hint: Don't worry! You can change your companion path or add more pets anytime in app settings.
